items.translation: 返回配置的ConversionService。

items.source: The LifecycleProcessor will call only this variant of the stop method; i.e. Lifecycle.stop() will not be called for SmartLifecycle implementations unless explicitly delegated to within the implementation of this method.
items.translation: `LifecycleProcessor` 将仅调用此版本的 `stop` 方法；即，除非在该方法的实现中显式委托，否则不会为 `SmartLifecycle` 实现调用 `Lifecycle.stop()`。

items.source: The default implementation returns SmartLifecycle.DEFAULT_PHASE in order to let stop() callbacks execute before regular Lifecycle implementations.
items.translation: 默认实现返回SmartLifecycle.DEFAULT_PHASE，以便在常规`Lifecycle`实现之前执行stop()回调。

items.source: The provided callback is used by the LifecycleProcessor to support an ordered, and potentially concurrent, shutdown of all components having a common shutdown order value. The callback must be executed after the SmartLifecycle component does indeed stop.
items.translation: 提供的回调由LifecycleProcessor使用，以支持具有公共关闭顺序值的所有组件的有序且可能并发的关闭。该回调必须在SmartLifecycle 组件确实停止后执行。

items.source: By default, this is SmartLifecycle.DEFAULT_PHASE, but with @EnableWebSocketMessageBroker configuration it is set to 0.
items.translation: 默认情况下，这是SmartLifecycle.DEFAULT_PHASE，但在使用@EnableWebSocketMessageBroker配置时，它被设置为 0。

items.source: By default, DefaultFormattingConversionService is used.
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用DefaultFormattingConversionService。

items.source: By default, AntPathMatcher is used.
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用AntPathMatcher。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to Lifecycle.stop() and immediately triggers the given callback in the calling thread. Note that there is no synchronization between the two, so custom implementations may at least want to put the same steps within their common lifecycle monitor (if any).
items.translation: 默认实现会委托给 Lifecycle.stop()，并立即在调用线程中触发给定的回调。请注意，这两者之间没有同步机制，因此自定义实现至少应该将其中的相同步骤放在其公共生命周期监视器（如果有）内。

items.source: Subclasses should also take into account custom argument types configured via AbstractMethodMessageHandler.setCustomArgumentResolvers(List).
items.translation: 子类还应考虑通过 AbstractMethodMessageHandler.setCustomArgumentResolvers(List) 配置的自定义参数类型。

items.source: Subclasses should also take into account custom return value types configured via AbstractMethodMessageHandler.setCustomReturnValueHandlers(List).
items.translation: 子类还应考虑通过AbstractMethodMessageHandler.setCustomReturnValueHandlers(List)配置的自定义返回值类型。

items.source: Note however that the remaining portion of a destination after the prefix may use a different separator (for example, commonly "." in messaging) depending on the configured PathMatcher.
items.translation: 不过请注意，在配置了 `<code>PathMatcher` 之后，目标路径前缀之后的剩余部分可能会使用不同的分隔符（例如，在消息传递中通常为 "."）。

items.source: Supports Ant-style path patterns with template variables.
items.translation: 支持带有模板变量的 Ant 风格路径模式。

items.source:
Destination prefixes are expected to be slash-separated Strings and
therefore a slash is automatically appended where missing to ensure a
proper prefix-based match (i.e. matching complete segments).
items.translation: 目标前缀预期为斜杠分隔的字符串，因此如果缺少斜杠会自动追加一个，以确保基于前缀的正确匹配（即匹配完整的段）。

items.source: Configure a MessageHeaderInitializer to pass on to HandlerMethodReturnValueHandlers that send messages from controller return values.
items.translation: 配置一个 `MessageHeaderInitializer` 以传递给将控制器返回值发送为消息的 `HandlerMethodReturnValueHandlers`。

items.source: Note that this stop notification is not guaranteed to come before destruction: On regular shutdown, Lifecycle beans will first receive a stop notification before the general destruction callbacks are being propagated; however, on hot refresh during a context's lifetime or on aborted refresh attempts, a given bean's destroy method will be called without any consideration of stop signals upfront.
items.translation: 请注意，此停止通知并不保证在销毁之前发出： 在常规关闭过程中，Lifecycle 圈会先接收停止通知，然后再传播通用的销毁回调；然而，在上下文生命周期期间的热刷新或中止的刷新尝试中，给定 bean 的销毁方法将在不考虑任何预先停止信号的情况下被调用。

items.source: Should not throw an exception if the component is not running (not started yet).
